name: Mochizuki Yousuke
source:
Personality: Hard Liner x Overprotective (normal), Carnivore x Possessive (Tlicolity)
Profession: Cameraman
Hobby: Cooking, Driving Around
Favorite food: Lightly Fried Tofu, Sake
Disliked food: Dairy Products

A photographer who is Natsume's senior.
He's taciturn and calm and usually acts rather than speaking.
Strong at the core, he always moves forward according to his beliefs.
He lives in a house next to Wataru and after Natsume starts living with Wataru he visits them almost everyday.
